episode_title: Daily Low-Dose Ketamine: Why Repetition May Matter More Than Intensity - Eiad Asbahi

real_qa.q: Why did Eiad Asbahi transition from running Prescience Point hedge fund to founding Mindscape?
real_qa.r: After 17 years managing Prescience Point and experiencing a major professional collapse when his largest investment position fell in September 2021 combined with personal divorce, Asbahi underwent deep inner healing through internal family systems therapy. This journey of healing became his passion, and the spark for Mindscape emerged as he searched for renewed motivation, eventually founding the platform to help others access the inner healing benefits he discovered through medically supervised ketamine care.
real_qa.requete: Eiad Asbahi Prescience Point Mindscape transition

real_qa.q: What is the core difference between Mindscape and other telemedicine ketamine platforms?
real_qa.r: Mindscape has stripped the frills and cost out of the medication compared to other platforms that bundle in premium services most people don't use. While offering free healing collateral and high-level customer support, Mindscape's key distinction is its daily dosing protocol rather than peak experience protocols, with the medication meant to be integrated into daily life for consistent practice in building self-relationship.
real_qa.requete: Mindscape daily dose ketamine platform model

real_qa.q: How does low-dose daily ketamine create space for self-observation according to Eiad Asbahi?
real_qa.r: Ketamine creates space between your thoughts, allowing you to fall into your body and feel completely present. When thoughts slow down, you can observe them as they arise rather than subconsciously suppressing them. Doing this consistently builds self-relationship through self-love, as you process thoughts with compassion and watch your system respond with more joy in simple things.
real_qa.requete: ketamine creates space between thoughts presence

real_qa.q: What does the daily ketamine protocol at Mindscape look like in practice?
real_qa.r: Asbahi takes ketamine daily to connect with himself rather than escape, using environmental framing like red lights and music. During experiences, the body takes over naturally—he uses a rebounder trampoline, stretches, and does vigorous movements. He also incorporates red light therapy for overall body stimulation and aliveness, allowing the body to guide itself toward what it needs.
real_qa.requete: Mindscape low-dose ketamine daily protocol practice

real_qa.q: How does Mindscape approach the distinction between therapeutic use and dependence on low-dose ketamine?
real_qa.r: Asbahi challenges the narrative that addiction automatically means harm, noting that drugs have been part of human civilization for 10,000 years and Mindscape receives daily emails from patients expressing gratitude for life-changing effects. Clinical decision makers determine individual protocols, and patients often leave and return as it suits them. However, tight container and accountability with prescribers are essential, as dosages can escalate from daily low doses to higher weekend doses if unsupervised.
real_qa.requete: low-dose ketamine addiction dependence daily use
